_comment: Every scientific claim shown in the app must point to a source in this list by id. All VERIFIED entries were consulted on 2026-11-12. 'notes' are shown in the UI (English).

sources.title: About High Blood Pressure
sources.notes: Blood pressure categories (normal, elevated, stage 1, stage 2) and the >180 systolic and/or >120 diastolic severe-hypertension threshold.

sources.title: Pulse
sources.notes: How to take a pulse (wrist, neck) and the adult resting range of 60 to 100 beats per minute.

sources.title: Low Blood Sugar (Hypoglycemia)
sources.notes: Low blood sugar is below 70 mg/dL; severe is below 54 mg/dL. The CDC treatment page cites 55 mg/dL for severe; this app uses 54 mg/dL from the definition page.

sources.title: Treatment of Low Blood Sugar (Hypoglycemia)
sources.notes: The 15-15 rule: 15 g of carbohydrate, wait 15 minutes, recheck. Severe low blood sugar needs glucagon and emergency care.

sources.title: Definitions of Signs, Symptoms, and Conditions of Ill Travelers
sources.notes: Fever is a measured temperature of 100.4 F (38 C) or higher. A measured temperature is the preferred method.

sources.title: FastStats: Sleep in Adults
sources.notes: Adults (18 and older) should get at least 7 hours of sleep each day.

sources.title: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) during spaceflight - a guideline for CPR in microgravity from the German Society of Aerospace Medicine (DGLRM) and the European Society of Aerospace Medicine Space Medicine Group (ESAM-SMG)
sources.publisher: Scandinavian Journal of Trauma, Resuscitation and Emergency Medicine (Hinkelbein et al., 2020)
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed guideline for CPR in microgravity (DOI 10.1186/s13049-020-00793-y). It gives no target compression rate or depth for microgravity.

sources.title: Hazard: Distance From Earth
sources.notes: Mars missions face a communication delay of up to 20 minutes one way.

sources.title: Speaking Percy's Language: How to Talk So Perseverance Will Listen
sources.notes: Commands take 3 to 22 minutes to reach the Perseverance rover on Mars, depending on planetary orbits.

sources.title: Ten things you didn't know about the Moon - Moon calling Earth
sources.notes: A signal takes on average 1.27 seconds to travel from the Moon to Earth.

sources.title: 5 Hazards of Human Spaceflight
sources.notes: NASA's overview of the main hazards that human spaceflight poses to crew health.

sources.title: NASA Open Science Data Repository
sources.notes: Real space biology datasets, to inspire and test the app. URL not yet verified.
